principles: Frontend files do not own discovery, crawling, filtering, or event cleanup rules.
data/event-sources.json is the durable registry for towns, sources, source configuration, and source notes.
data/events.json is an append/update-oriented event history consumed by the app.
Routine event refreshes reuse known sources; they do not perform broad source rediscovery unless explicitly requested.
New town work and explicit rediscovery work must record both found and not_found source-type results so future runs do not repeat the same search.

relationshipRules: source.townId is the source or venue's primary physical town when there is one.
source.servesTownIds lists towns served by a regional, county, library-system, mall, or nearby venue source.
event.townId means the event's actual location town, not the source's service area.
A source may have multiple sourceTypes.

statusVocabulary.importable: Importer should automatically read this source and write or update events.
statusVocabulary.manual_review: Useful source, but no stable importer exists yet or human review is needed.
statusVocabulary.service_area: Town is covered by a broader source or shared system.
statusVocabulary.blocked_by_bot_protection: Useful source, but direct script fetching is blocked.
statusVocabulary.reference_only: Keep for planning or discovery; do not import events automatically.
statusVocabulary.not_found: A source type was checked for a town and no useful dated-event source was found.
statusVocabulary.broken: A previously useful source or parser is currently failing and needs review.

workflows.label: Add a new town
workflows.defaultDateWindow: today forward; keep historical events already stored
steps: Create or update the town record with stable id, official name, county, state, ZIPs when known, and center coordinates when available.
Use data/source-taxonomy.json to search across all source families, not only government and library sources.
Record every useful source in data/event-sources.json with sourceTypes, status, URL fields, parser or parser notes, and service-town relationships.
Record not_found discovery results for source families that were searched but produced no useful dated-event source.
For importable sources, reuse or add parser configuration and import kid/family-compatible events from today forward.
Normalize events into data/events.json while preserving older historical records.
Run validation and record any unresolved source or event quality issues.

workflows.label: Refresh known sources
workflows.defaultDateWindow: today through source lookahead window; default 60 days unless source config says otherwise
steps: Read known importable and configured manual sources from data/event-sources.json.
Reuse stored parser names, endpoints, parameters, fallback locations, and notes.
Fetch current events from each source without deleting historical events.
Merge events by stable event id or duplicate matching rules.
Update lastSeenAt for observed events and firstSeenAt for new events.
Do not mark missing future events as cancelled unless the official source explicitly says cancelled.
Record parser failures on the source with lastFailedImportAt and lastFailureReason when practical.
doesNotDo: Broad web search for newly opened venues

workflows.label: Manually add a source
steps: Ask whether the user wants registration only or registration plus immediate event import if the request is ambiguous.
Classify the source using data/source-taxonomy.json.
Record URL, sourceTypes, townId, servesTownIds, status, and parser notes.
If events should be imported immediately, capture source evidence and normalize eligible events into data/events.json.
If no stable importer is available, keep the source as manual_review with enough notes to revisit efficiently.

workflows.label: Rediscover sources for a town
steps: Use this workflow only when explicitly asked or when adding a new town.
Search each source family in data/source-taxonomy.json for the town, county, and nearby relevant venues.
Look for newly opened or previously missed malls, play venues, kids gyms, bookstores, farms, museums, parks, and community sources.
Add new useful sources, update changed URLs or statuses, and record not_found checks.
Do not import events until the source is classified and the user request includes import/update work or the add-town workflow requires it.

mergeRules.sourceId: Stable source ids should not change when URLs, parser names, or notes change.
eventId: Prefer sourceId + upstream externalId + event date.
If no externalId exists, use sourceId + normalized title + startsAt + venue hash.
Avoid creating a new event for small title, URL, or summary changes.
duplicatePreference: Official town, county, library, or partner repost
